title: Foundation CUIC takes Odido to court over February hack over compensation claim
date_note: NOS gives only its own publication day, 27 November; it says the summons was filed at the start of November.
summary: NOS reports that Stichting CUIC has summoned Odido on behalf of ruim 500.000 people over the hack Odido suffered last February, when personal data of ruim 6 miljoen customers became public. The claim comes to ten minste 500 euro per persoon, NOS says. Odido's spokesperson said the company takes the claim seriously; the court has not yet ruled on liability.
plain: A consumer foundation is suing Odido for ten minste 500 euro per persoon over last February's hack, on behalf of ruim 500.000 people. The court has not ruled yet.
exec: A collective claim of ten minste 500 euro per persoon for ruim 500.000 people hits Odido over the February hack; no court ruling yet.

sources.name: NOS: Stichting sleept Odido voor rechter voor schadevergoeding van ten minste 500 euro na hack

De claim komt neer op ten minste 500 euro per persoon.
persoonsgegevens van ruim 6 miljoen klanten belandden toen in de openbaarheid
